summary: Define Env DSL portable environment constants standard

delivery.outcome: Define Env DSL v1 as a portable inert SNAKE_CASE constants, expressions and conditions standard with deterministic conformance and Wellmanifest DSL metadata
nonGoals: Do not edit wellmanifest/dsl/src/dsl_check.py in this repository
Do not define or transport secrets
Do not source documents, invoke host-language eval, interpolate process state or perform effects; expression evaluation is limited to the deterministic Env DSL operator semantics
Do not implement language-specific loaders, regex compilers, a CLI or a daemon
Do not create a remote repository, push, merge, tag or publish this target in the seed transaction

architecture.decision: Use a strict dotenv-shaped data language, a language-neutral ABNF grammar and a dependency-free conformance checker; suffix-typed equations are parsed and evaluated by deterministic Env DSL semantics while host conversion and effects remain consumer-owned
interfaceChanges: Publish the Env DSL v1 document, layering, expression and condition semantics
Publish stable ENV-* conformance diagnostic codes
dataChanges: Represent environment constants as inert SNAKE_CASE=value records
Represent regular expressions as literal pattern text without host-language constructors
Represent derived scalar equations as *_EXPRESSION and boolean equations as *_CONDITION using explicit @SNAKE_CASE references
architecture.rollback: Before publication, revert the ticket implementation commits; after publication, retain v1 and prepare a backward-compatible successor
